name: c1_01-display-keys
note: U-12: legacy C1_01, plain, no movement. HDD page keys F1/F5 each followed by Enter (100-130: hud_key 432e60); F11 at 150 opens the objectives screen 0x457538, answered by a pump-keyed Enter (button 0 closes it); Esc 200 (display mode 1), F1 240 (432cf0), Esc 280; F10 320 (outside view, mode 4: the panel-off byte H+20Fh makes hud_key pass every key to command_key): Enter 370 (4604eb), N 380 (46046e..4604c5), Backspace 390, T 400, Backspace 410 (46057c both), Alt+Num+ 420 without the cheat flag (4601f7 taken), V 430, N 470, Esc 480 (46069f: 4606a8); then F1 540 and Esc 580 in the following side view (432cf6, 432dea), F9 640, F1 690, Esc 730 (432cf8, 432dec). Display-mode effects are hypotheses: the discovery watch display_mode 0x4d24c0@0x14 shows each mode. Bounded window of 800 frames.
